featured_reviews.review_text: Vibrant society of ~57 apartments and 6 shops on Mumbai's oldest & busiest arterial road - S.V. Road. The building is 8-storeyed across 3 wings and is constructed on a half acre plot in prime Santacruz West area. The proximity to public transport such as Metro (just opposite upcoming S'cruz West Metro station), Local Western Rail (5 minute walk with skywalk connection just a skip from the building gate), bus stop opposite the building for SV Road commute across entire length of the city in either direction and 5 minute walk for bus stop on Linking Road, taxi stand and no dearth of rickshaws just outside the building. In short, you can plan travel to any part of the city and even fly out with ease (domestic & international airport just 2 kms and 4 kms respectively). The area is dotted with green spaces such as Lions Juhu Garden and Muktanand Park just 5 minute's walk away. Also, the seashore is less than a 5 minute's drive to Juhu beach. Not just that, there are more than half a dozen schools in close proximity across boards - International, ICSE, CBSE and SSC. Did I mention the bustling suburban market where you can buy everything of need and cover it within a phone call. Also, hospitals such as Surya (Women & Children), Nanavati (Multispecialty now owned by Max chain) and PD Hinduja Hospital (Multispecialty) are in arc of minimum fare by rickshaw. The buzzing commerce of high-end retail, fast fashion, glitzy F&B joints, banks etc have all made their home around the building and expanded rapidly in recent years with big format stores such as Marks & Spencer, H&M, Vijay Sales, Croma, Tanishq etc. There's something for everyone including the devotional with Jain temple, Laxmi Narayan Mandir, Sacred Heart Church and S'cruz Masjid located just 5-6 minute's walk in 4 different directions. A location so rare in terms of the advantage & benefits to its residents, tenants, shop owners & customers that it will remain a landmark for decades to come as it has been for the last 6+ decades

Overall, it feels like a thoughtfully designed option for long-term urban living in Mumbai.
